fixture=home-fresh cmd=--help.output:
DESCRIPTION
  Portable AI coding agent config kit — SoT sync engine + helpers for Claude Code, Codex, and universal agent skills.

USAGE
  docks-kit <subcommand> [flags]

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|sh>                                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, sh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)

SUBCOMMANDS
  sync         Deploy the SoT to this machine with EngineNative. Deploy-time modifiers touch deployed config only; a later flag-less sync reverts them to SoT.
  update       Self-update the kit: autodetects the install (git checkout -> ff-only pull; bun/npm global -> @latest) and chains an install-missing-only sync with the new version (--no-sync to skip).
  model        Get or set the DEPLOYED model for one tool without a full sync (deploy-time modifier semantics: SoT untouched; flag-less sync reverts).
  models       List kit-verified Claude and Codex models (SoT/models.json).
  toolchain    Verified-version floors for external tools (SoT/toolchain.json): check prints the doctor table; ensure installs/upgrades one managed tool per policy (above-verified versions prompt; --yes accepts).
  status       Doctor view: deployed-vs-SoT drift, toolchain, and plugin/skill counts.
  plugins      Installed plugins vs SoT enabledPlugins tri-state (read-only).
  skills       Universal agent skills: SoT/.agents/skills.txt vs ~/.agents/skills + the ~/.claude/skills symlink health (read-only).
  docs         Self-documentation: the kit's concepts as readable topics, bundled with the CLI — a fresh agent can learn the kit from here alone.
